fields.label: Promotion Name
fields.description: Name shown at POS, e.g. Breakfast Bundle

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Master switch. Unchecked = cannot be used at any outlet

fields.label: Root Company
fields.description: Organisation fence: every outlet below must belong under this company

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Must match the default currency of every outlet company

fields.label: Promo Product & Price
fields.description: The customer pays one package price: Base Price plus any choice adjustments below

fields.label: Parent Item
fields.description: Non-stock sellable item that represents this package at POS. It must not have any selling Item Price

fields.label: Base Price
fields.description: Package price before choice adjustments (must be greater than 0)

fields.label: Valid From
fields.description: Leave empty for no start limit

fields.label: Valid To
fields.description: Leave empty for no end date

fields.label: Max Packages Per Invoice
fields.description: Maximum packages of this promotion in one sales invoice. 0 = unlimited

fields.label: Fixed Components
fields.description: Items always included in every package, in fixed quantity. Leave empty if everything is customer-chosen

fields.label: Customer Choices — Groups
fields.description: Each group is one decision the customer makes, e.g. Pick 1 Bread. Every group needs at least 2 options

fields.label: Customer Choices — Options
fields.description: The selectable items of each group. Price Adjustment is added to (or subtracted from) Base Price per unit chosen

fields.label: Where Active (Outlets)
fields.description: The promotion only applies at the exact Company + Warehouse pairs listed here with Enabled checked. No rows = not available anywhere
